title: TimestampV1
description: Normative timebase contract for SIH26168 defining monotonic scientific epoch, hardware arrival clock, and clock domain identification.

epoch_ns.description: Canonical 64-bit nanosecond monotonic scientific epoch time.

arrival_elapsed_realtime_ns.description: Monotonic nanoseconds from android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() recorded at callback arrival.

source_timestamp_ns.description: Optional raw sensor hardware callback timestamp in nanoseconds.

clock_id.description: Identifier string designating the clock domain.
